about_the_game:
R.A.S.P Mobility-Unit

Third-Person Retro Arcade Tactical Military Shooter

Step into the boots of elite operatives in R.A.S.P Mobility-Unit, a fast-paced, retro-inspired tactical shooter that pits Military Forces against a ruthless Terrorist Faction across intense, global battlegrounds.

From dense jungle warzones and sun-scorched deserts to snow-capped mountain strongholds and secret underground bunkers.

Whether you're teaming up with friends or diving into solo action, R.A.S.P delivers adrenaline-fueled combat with classic arcade flair and modern tactical depth.

Customize your online or single-player lobbies and experience a perfect blend of nostalgic shooter action and fresh, competitive gameplay.

Game Modes Include:

Bomb & Defuse – Plant or defuse explosives in strategic locations.

Team Deathmatch – Classic all-out war. Eliminate the opposing team.

Rush – Destroy two objectives to push the frontline forward.

Kill Confirmed – Take down enemies and collect dog tags for points.

Conquest – Capture and hold control points to dominate the battlefield.

Capture The Flag (CTF) – Steal the enemy flag and return it to base.

Free For All – Every soldier for themselves. No allies. No mercy.

R.A.S.P Mobility-Unit – Old-School Feel. New-School Thrill.

The battle begins now. Will you rise to the challenge?

content_descriptors.notes: Military Tactical Shooter, with killing or destroying the enemy team is part of the game. Planting / defusing bombs or just killing all that oppose you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD or Intel 3.0Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB Graphics Card or Higher recommended
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Anything better than Onboard recommended
  • VR Support: NO
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD or Intel 3.5Ghz
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6GB Graphics Card or Higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: SoundBlaster or Better
  • VR Support: NO

short_description: R.A.S.P Mobility-Unit - Is a Retro Arcade Third-Person Tactical Shooter, with a realistic Military theme. We love the old school shooter feeling from 2000 Era games on the Play Station, and N64. f you are a fan of the classics you will love R.A.S.P Mobility-Unit our Retro Arcade Shooter.
